en.name: Meta tags
en.short: Preview your page in Google, LinkedIn, X and WhatsApp and get the meta tags.
en.title: Meta tags generator with Google and social previews
en.description: Fill in the title, description and image and see how your page will look in Google, LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and WhatsApp, with a warning when text will be cut. Generates the '<'meta'>', Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ready to paste.
en.h1: Meta tags and Open Graph generator
en.lead: Write your title and description once and check how every platform will show them.
en.imageHint: Previews load the image from its URL. Use an absolute HTTPS URL; 1200 × 630 px works everywhere.
en.placeholderDescription: A short summary of the page that makes people want to click.

es.h1: Generador de meta tags y Open Graph
es.lead: Escribe tu título y tu descripción una vez y comprueba cómo los mostrará cada plataforma.
es.imageHint: Las vistas previas cargan la imagen desde su URL. Usa una URL HTTPS absoluta; 1200 × 630 px funciona en todas partes.
es.placeholderDescription: Un resumen breve de la página que invite a hacer clic.
